selection.rule: lowest SHA256(seed, instance_id) per repo; no labels or outcomes

config.cache: fresh snapshot and index per task
config.failure_policy: empty candidates; retain task in coverage denominator if gold exists

evaluation.primary: macro candidate coverage: menu oracle minus fixed identifiers+prose
evaluation.oracle_objective: candidate coverage only; ties by fewer actions then action names
evaluation.threshold_status: engineering continuation threshold, not expected improvement
evaluation.interval: paired repository-cluster bootstrap; descriptive only on reused data
evaluation.multiplicity: one primary contrast; other contrasts descriptive
evaluation.gold_policy: exact canonical IDs; retain unindexed targets in denominator
evaluation.failure_policy: empty candidates; retain task in coverage denominator if gold exists

limits: historically used Lite tasks; not an unseen test set
lexical menu only; no adaptive evidence state
RRF pilot ranking, not the strongest learned fusion ranker
all-menu execution is diagnostic and may exceed deployment budget
source size cap is checked after snapshot read, not a hard IO limit
no wall-time cutoff; elapsed time reported, not claimed equal
